WITH __kumo_keys__ AS (
  SELECT key AS __kumo_batch__, CAST(json_extract(value, '$[0]') AS INTEGER) AS __kumo_id__, CAST(json_extract(value, '$[1]') AS TEXT) AS __kumo_end__, CAST(json_extract(value, '$[2]') AS TEXT) AS __kumo_start__
  FROM json_each(?)
)
SELECT tmp.__kumo_batch__ as __kumo_batch__, "purchased_at"
FROM __kumo_keys__ tmp
JOIN "purchases"
  ON "customer_id" = tmp.__kumo_id__
 AND "purchased_at" <= tmp.__kumo_end__
 AND "purchased_at" > tmp.__kumo_start__
ORDER BY __kumo_batch__, "purchased_at", "purchase_id"

WITH __kumo_keys__ AS (
  SELECT key AS __kumo_batch__, CAST(json_extract(value, '$[0]') AS INTEGER) AS __kumo_id__, CAST(json_extract(value, '$[1]') AS TEXT) AS __kumo_end__, CAST(json_extract(value, '$[2]') AS TEXT) AS __kumo_start__
  FROM json_each(?)
)
SELECT tmp.__kumo_batch__ as __kumo_batch__, "purchased_at"
FROM __kumo_keys__ tmp
JOIN "purchases"
  ON "customer_id" = tmp.__kumo_id__
 AND "purchased_at" <= tmp.__kumo_end__
 AND "purchased_at" > tmp.__kumo_start__
ORDER BY __kumo_batch__, "purchased_at", "purchase_id"

WITH __kumo_keys__ AS (
  SELECT key AS __kumo_batch__, CAST(value AS INTEGER) AS __kumo_id__
  FROM json_each(?)
)
SELECT tmp.__kumo_batch__ as __kumo_batch__, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "customers" WHERE "customer_id" == tmp.__kumo_id__) as __kumo_matches__, "customer_id", "segment", "signup_at"
FROM __kumo_keys__ tmp
JOIN "customers" ent
  ON ent.rowid = (
    SELECT rowid
    FROM "customers"
    WHERE "customer_id" == tmp.__kumo_id__
    ORDER BY "customer_id", "segment", "signup_at", rowid
    LIMIT 1
)

WITH __kumo_keys__ AS (
  SELECT key AS __kumo_batch__, CAST(json_extract(value, '$[0]') AS INTEGER) AS __kumo_id__, CAST(json_extract(value, '$[1]') AS TEXT) AS __kumo_time__
  FROM json_each(?)
)
SELECT tmp.__kumo_batch__ as __kumo_batch__, "purchase_id", "customer_id", "item_id", "amount", "purchased_at", "store_code"
FROM __kumo_keys__ tmp
JOIN "purchases" fact
ON fact.rowid IN (
  SELECT rowid
  FROM "purchases"
  WHERE "customer_id" = tmp.__kumo_id__
  AND "purchased_at" <= tmp.__kumo_time__
  ORDER BY "purchased_at" DESC, "purchase_id", "amount", "customer_id", "item_id", "store_code"
  LIMIT 8
)
ORDER BY __kumo_batch__, "purchased_at" DESC, "purchase_id", "amount", "customer_id", "item_id", "store_code"
